#kcau-progms{
        display: flex;
        justify-content: center !important;
	align-items: center;
        flex-flow: wrap;
        margin: 0;
        height: 100%;
}
 button.kcau-progms {
      
        border: none;
        background-color: #e0e0e0;
        box-shadow: 0px 0px 7px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
    -moz-box-shadow: 0px 0px 7px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
	      border-radius: 5px;
        color: #000;
        cursor: pointer;
        padding: 10px 12px;
        display: inline-block;
        margin: 10px 12px;
        font-weight: 700;
        font-size: 0.9em;
        outline: none;
        position: relative;
        -webkit-transition: all 0.3s;
        transition: all 0.3s;
    }
 button.kcau-progms:before {
        content: '';
        display: block;
        border-radius: 8px;
        position: absolute;
        left: 40px;
        right: 40px;
        top: -8px;
        bottom: -8px;
        background-color: #000000;
        border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
        border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
        opacity: 0.6;
        z-index: -1;
        -webkit-transition: all 0.3s;
        transition: all 0.3s;
    }
    
  button.kcau-progms:hover:before,
    button.kcau-progms.hover:before {
        left: 0px;
        right: 0px;
        top: -5px;
        bottom: -5px;
        opacity: 1;
    }
button.kcau-progms:active:before {
        top: -3px;
        bottom: -3px;
        -webkit-transition: all 0.1s;
        transition: all 0.1s;
    }
    
    button.kcau-progms.kcau-gold:before {
        background-color: #d0b216;
    }
   
    button.kcau-progms.kcau-navy:before {
        background-color: #182b5c;
    }

}

	/* ── Field group ── */
  .field-group {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 5px;
  }

.wpforms-container-full .wpforms-field-label {
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    text-transform: capitalize;
    color: var(--kcau-navy-500);
  }

  .field-label .required {
    color: var(--kcau-gold-500);
    margin-left: 2px;
  }
	
  .consent-item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 10px;
    padding: 0.5rem 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--kcau-navy-200);
  }

  .consent-item:last-child {
    border-bottom: none;
  }

  .consent-item input[type="checkbox"] {
    width: 18px; height: 18px;
    margin-top: 1px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    accent-color: var(--kcau-gold-400);
    cursor: pointer;
  }

  .consent-text {
    font-size: 13px;
    color: var(--kcau-navy-600);
    line-height: 1.5;
  }

  .consent-text strong {
    color: var(--kcau-navy-500);
    font-weight: 600;
  }

  /* ── Divider ── */
  .form-divider {
    height: 1px;
    background: var(--kcau-navy-100);
    margin: 1.5rem 0;
  }

  /* ── Submit ── */
  .form-footer {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 1rem;
    padding-top: 1.5rem;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--kcau-navy-100);
  }

  .footer-note {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: var(--kcau-navy-300);
    font-family: var(--font-body);
  }

  .footer-note a {
    color: var(--kcau-gold-500);
    text-decoration: underline;
  }

  .wpforms-submit {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    padding: 0.8rem 2.25rem;
    background: var(--grad-primary);
    color: #fff;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 8px;
    font-family: var(--font-display);
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 2px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    cursor: pointer;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-gold);
    transition: opacity 0.2s, transform 0.1s;
		margin-bottom:20px;
  }

 .wpforms-submit:hover {
    opacity: 0.92;
    transform: translateY(-1px);
  }

 .wpforms-submit:active {
    transform: translateY(0);
  }
}

<style id="wp-custom-css">

#kcau-progms{
        display: flex;
        justify-content: center !important;
	align-items: center;
        flex-flow: wrap;
        margin: 0;
        height: 100%;
}
 button.kcau-progms {
      
        border: none;
        background-color: #e0e0e0;
        box-shadow: 0px 0px 7px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
    -moz-box-shadow: 0px 0px 7px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
	      border-radius: 5px;
        color: #000;
        cursor: pointer;
        padding: 10px 12px;
        display: inline-block;
        margin: 10px 12px;
        font-weight: 700;
        font-size: 0.9em;
        outline: none;
        position: relative;
        -webkit-transition: all 0.3s;
        transition: all 0.3s;
    }
 button.kcau-progms:before {
        content: '';
        display: block;
        border-radius: 8px;
        position: absolute;
        left: 40px;
        right: 40px;
        top: -8px;
        bottom: -8px;
        background-color: #000000;
        border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
        border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
        opacity: 0.6;
        z-index: -1;
        -webkit-transition: all 0.3s;
        transition: all 0.3s;
    }
    
  button.kcau-progms:hover:before,
    button.kcau-progms.hover:before {
        left: 0px;
        right: 0px;
        top: -5px;
        bottom: -5px;
        opacity: 1;
    }
button.kcau-progms:active:before {
        top: -3px;
        bottom: -3px;
        -webkit-transition: all 0.1s;
        transition: all 0.1s;
    }
    
    button.kcau-progms.kcau-gold:before {
        background-color: #d0b216;
    }
   
    button.kcau-progms.kcau-navy:before {
        background-color: #182b5c;
    }

/* ── Privacy Notice ── */
 .kcau-privacy {
    margin: 0;

    padding: 1rem 1.5rem;
  }

  .privacy-title {
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 2px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--kcau-gold-7600);
    margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
  }

 .kingster-body p.privacy-text {
    font-size: 12.5px!important;
    line-height: 1.65;
    color: #4a4a2a;
  }

  .privacy-text a {
    color: var(--kcau-gold-500);
    text-decoration: underline;
  }

    padding: 2rem 2.5rem 2.5rem;

    margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
  }
	.wpforms-form .wpforms-field-divider h3{

	    color: var(--kcau-navy-500);

	/* ── Field group ── */
  .field-group {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 5px;
  }

.wpforms-container-full .wpforms-field-label {
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    text-transform: capitalize;
    color: var(--kcau-navy-500);
  }

  .field-label .required {
    color: var(--kcau-gold-500);
    margin-left: 2px;
  }
	
  .consent-item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 10px;
    padding: 0.5rem 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--kcau-navy-200);
  }

  .consent-item:last-child {
    border-bottom: none;
  }

  .consent-item input[type="checkbox"] {
    width: 18px; height: 18px;
    margin-top: 1px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    accent-color: var(--kcau-gold-400);
    cursor: pointer;
  }

  .consent-text {
    font-size: 13px;
    color: var(--kcau-navy-600);
    line-height: 1.5;
  }

  .consent-text strong {
    color: var(--kcau-navy-500);
    font-weight: 600;
  }

  /* ── Divider ── */
  .form-divider {
    height: 1px;
    background: var(--kcau-navy-100);
    margin: 1.5rem 0;
  }

  /* ── Submit ── */
  .form-footer {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 1rem;
    padding-top: 1.5rem;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--kcau-navy-100);
  }

  .footer-note {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: var(--kcau-navy-300);
    font-family: var(--font-body);
  }

  .footer-note a {
    color: var(--kcau-gold-500);
    text-decoration: underline;
  }

  .wpforms-submit {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    padding: 0.8rem 2.25rem;
    background: var(--grad-primary);
    color: #fff;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 8px;
    font-family: var(--font-display);
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 2px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    cursor: pointer;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-gold);
    transition: opacity 0.2s, transform 0.1s;
		margin-bottom:20px;
  }

 .wpforms-submit:hover {
    opacity: 0.92;
    transform: translateY(-1px);
  }

 .wpforms-submit:active {
    transform: translateY(0);
  }

</span><div class="gdlr-core-title-item-title-wrap clearfix" ><h2 class="gdlr-core-title-item-title gdlr-core-skin-title " style="font-size: 26px ;"  >Research, Innovation & Incubation</h2></div></div></div><div class="gdlr-core-pbf-element" ><div class="gdlr-core-text-box-item gdlr-core-item-pdlr gdlr-core-item-pdb gdlr-core-left-align" style="padding-bottom: 0px ;"  ><div class="gdlr-core-text-box-item-content" style="font-size: 17px ;font-weight: 500 ;text-transform: none ;"  ><p style="text-align: justify;">At KCA University, Research and Innovation is one of our strategic pillars in the academic vision. As a renowned center of excellence in both teaching and research, we are committed to fostering a culture of innovation and advancing knowledge in various fields. <div class="content">
<div class="greeting"><strong>Dear Students,</strong></div>
<div class="highlight-box" style="margin-top: 20px;">
<p>Congratulations to the graduating Class of November 2026 on this remarkable achievement! Our <strong>21<sup>st</sup> KCA University Graduation Ceremony</strong> will be held on <strong>Friday, 27<sup>th</sup> November 2026</strong>. Students who have successfully completed their course should apply for graduation by <strong>Friday, 23<sup>rd</sup> October 2026</strong>, by (i) initiating the graduation clearance process from the Student Portal, (ii) ensuring coursework and attachment reports are submitted to their respective school, and (iii) clearing any pending fees, including graduation fees, with the Student Finance Office.</p>
<p style="margin-top: 12px;">For graduation enquiries, write to <a href="mailto:graduation@kcau.ac.ke">graduation@kcau.ac.ke</a>.</p>
<p><a href="https://www.kcau.ac.ke/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/MEMO-CLEARANCE-FOR-THE-21ST-GRADUATION-CEREMONY-1.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><br />
Download the full memo for more info.<br />
</a></p>

<style id="wp-custom-css">

#kcau-progms{
        display: flex;
        justify-content: center !important;
	align-items: center;
        flex-flow: wrap;
        margin: 0;
        height: 100%;
}
 button.kcau-progms {
      
        border: none;
        background-color: #e0e0e0;
        box-shadow: 0px 0px 7px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
    -moz-box-shadow: 0px 0px 7px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
	      border-radius: 5px;
        color: #000;
        cursor: pointer;
        padding: 10px 12px;
        display: inline-block;
        margin: 10px 12px;
        font-weight: 700;
        font-size: 0.9em;
        outline: none;
        position: relative;
        -webkit-transition: all 0.3s;
        transition: all 0.3s;
    }
 button.kcau-progms:before {
        content: '';
        display: block;
        border-radius: 8px;
        position: absolute;
        left: 40px;
        right: 40px;
        top: -8px;
        bottom: -8px;
        background-color: #000000;
        border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
        border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
        opacity: 0.6;
        z-index: -1;
        -webkit-transition: all 0.3s;
        transition: all 0.3s;
    }
    
  button.kcau-progms:hover:before,
    button.kcau-progms.hover:before {
        left: 0px;
        right: 0px;
        top: -5px;
        bottom: -5px;
        opacity: 1;
    }
button.kcau-progms:active:before {
        top: -3px;
        bottom: -3px;
        -webkit-transition: all 0.1s;
        transition: all 0.1s;
    }
    
    button.kcau-progms.kcau-gold:before {
        background-color: #d0b216;
    }
   
    button.kcau-progms.kcau-navy:before {
        background-color: #182b5c;
    }

.honorary-alumni-section{color:#000;line-height:1.6;padding:2rem;background-color:#f9f9f9}.honorary-alumni-section h2{color:#CBAE2D;font-size:1.8rem;margin-bottom:1rem}.honorary-alumni-list{border-left:5px solid #CBAE2D;padding-left:1.5rem;margin-bottom:2rem}.honorary-alumni-list p{margin:0.5rem 0}.highlight{color:#192C57;font-weight:bold}.note{background-color:#192C57;color:#fff;padding:1rem;border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);margin-top:2rem}.note strong{color:#CBAE2D}



 

/* Extra large devices (large laptops and desktops, 1200px and up) */
@media only screen and (max-width: 1200px) {
  button.kcau-progms {
        padding: 10px 10px;
        margin: 10px 5px;
        font-weight: 600;
       font-size: 12px;
	}
}
/* Large devices (laptops/desktops, 992px and up) */
@media only screen and (max-width: 992px) {
    button.kcau-progms {
            padding: 10px 1px;
    margin: 10px 3px;
    font-weight: 600;
    font-size: 12px;
	}
}
@media only screen and (max-width: 885px) {
    button.kcau-progms {
            padding: 10px 1px;
    margin: 10px 1px;
    font-weight: 600;
    font-size: 12px;
}
}

/* Medium devices (landscape tablets, 768px and up) */
@media only screen and (max-width: 768px) {
      button.kcau-progms {
        padding: 10px 15px;
        margin: 10px 15px;
        font-weight: 500;
       font-size: 14px;
				min-width:126px;
	}
	#kcau-progms{
   display: flex;
		text-align:justify;
	}
	button.kcau-progms:before{
		min-width:70px;
	}
} 


@media only screen and (max-width: 600px) {
  button.kcau-progms {
        padding: 10px 5px;
    margin: 10px 5px;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 13px;
	}
} 

@media only screen and (max-width: 400px) {
  button.kcau-progms {
    padding: 10px 2px;
    margin: 10px 2px;
    font-weight: 600;
    font-size: 12px;
}
